title: Observations on the Bring's surface
html: On Bring's surface, the observation morphism \mathfrak{O} \colon A \to A acts fibrewise on the state bundle \mathcal{S} \to M and perturbs the substrate parameter q(p), shifting the non-commutative geometry. The two-observer parallelogram applies directly: two independent observations of a fermion on Bring's surface produce a discrepancy controlled by the local Planck constant \hbar_q(p).
